description: Which ledgers and voucher types Zobrx's vouchers need that the Tally company does not have, all at once (Tally itself names only one per push). Based on the last masters snapshot the Tally extension synced (see fetchedAt); stock items are not checked here. Includes salesReturnGst: whether a sale-return push would actually reverse GST, since a missing output GST ledger lets a credit note import and reverse none of the tax, silently.

tallyCompanyName.description: Tally company name. Defaults to the company of the latest sync, then the primary company in Tally setup.
